name: Actions
purpose: canonical user-triggered action declarations, presentation metadata and binding to external domain action execution
owns: binding from a presented control to a domain-defined action reference

rules: id is presentation/action identity, not domain execution behavior
label is canonical action presentation text
action is the external domain action reference

binding.executor: external function supplied by the owning domain/integration layer
binding.WebEngineRole: bind user intent and presentation metadata to the external action reference
mustNot: infer authorization from control visibility or disabled state
turn Navigation into Actions or Actions into Navigation

rules: button/action labels are owned by Actions
Actions declares and binds user intent but does not own domain business behavior
action execution belongs to the owning domain service
authorization for an action/resource is decided by AccessCore when required
presentation visibility is not a security boundary
binding cleanup removes only the listener owned by that binding
action executor failure does not mutate the canonical Action record
